documents.title: Intent and scope
documents.excerpt: VaticanOps represents 8 curated public-procedure summaries mapped to the provided six Vatican publications. It supports navigation and audit, not legal advice, institutional authority or task execution. This is a deliberately partial corpus; more article-level review is needed for completeness.

documents.title: Semantic boundary
documents.excerpt: Owns: editor-defined procedure and step identifiers VO-PXX, source-linked transition descriptions, project labels, statuses.

documents.title: Native model — ARK-04
documents.excerpt: canon/domain/vaticanops.procedures.json: each procedure has an entry description, conditional nodes and guarded edges, role labels, scope, caveats, evidence references, and editor/authority metadata. Some branches have no executable resolution and should remain descriptive. A kind=outcome node is not a recorded…

documents.title: Epistemics
documents.excerpt: All nodes: source_mapped_unreviewed; all procedures: source_mapped_editorial_draft; legal applicability: not_legally_reviewed. An identified article proves attribution to a captured version, not authoritative interpretation or current force of law. No promotion to reviewed without an independent record of review.

documents.title: Canonical and derived
documents.excerpt: The three files registered in canon/state.index.json are the sole editorial logical content commitments in this initial version. sources/DocVatican stores externally obtained physical files, sources/source-inventory.json documents their hashes; these are not promoted as canonical normative claims. derived/, ai/,…

documents.title: Orientations
documents.excerpt: Primary view axis: procedural domain; secondary axis: cited source. Secondary views can navigate by role, step, article number, source date or unknown legal validity; they should not treat uncertainty as falsehood. The projections/recipes/procedures-by-domain.projection.json recipe remains derived.
